messages.subject: Equivalent to qqmathline
parts:
Hi!

I am trying to replicate plots like these with ggplot: http://dl.dropbox.com/u/6281903/ospan-qqplots.pdf. I have no trouble replicating the dots, I'm struggling with the lines. Here's my code:

p <- ggplot(subset(d.molten, variable%in%c("pcu","pcl","anu","anl")), aes(sample=value))
pqq <- p + geom_point(stat="qq") + facet_wrap(~variable) + theme_bw()
pqq

I tried to do the line with geom_line and geom_abline but I have no idea what the parameters should be. The dataframe is molten such that there's a column with the variables and another column with the respective values.

Best,
Paul
